scope: Posthoc diagnosis of already inspected V21 train/development. Not fresh validation, new training, control qualification, or a causal-identification claim. Truth replacements are diagnostic oracles only.
support: Same complete-UNION-horizon support as V21 original full-cost decision gate, also for actual_unique comparisons: 833 train and 272 development calls. No terminal imputation or additional subset selection.
repair_decomposition: Let r00=regret(M+R), r10=regret(Tanchor+R), r01=regret(M+Dtruth), r11=regret(Tanchor+Dtruth)=0. Motion repair contribution=.5*((r00-r10)+(r01-r11)); response repair contribution=.5*((r00-r01)+(r10-r11)). Contributions sum to r00, may be negative, are descriptive order-averaged oracle replacements, not identified causal effects or achievable performance bounds.
diagnostics: All seeds, configurations and both candidate populations. Preserve all costs/choices/regrets, group-equal regret and tie-optimal rates, helps/harms/unchanged vs own_motion, best-two predicted margins, true-choice response magnitudes, additive repair contributions, centered ranking-cost errors and response-cost contrast error. No truth-dependent gate, threshold/loss sweep, best-seed selection or model promotion.

bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive intervals across already inspected mirror groups, not holdout inference.
